mono-3539.d: A harmonograph trace: two damped pendulums per axis tuned a twelfth apart (3:1), drawn as the pen slowly comes to rest. Science-lab elegance.

mono-3576.d: The Lorenz attractor, integrated step by step from its equations (σ 10, ρ 28, β 8/3) and seen from front: one line that never crosses itself. Hypnotic from across the room.
